name: lv_indev_get_point

provenance.source: Exact .179 firmware IDA: 36-byte body byte-identical to the reviewed .155 function; copies two signed 32-bit pointer coordinates from indev offsets 56 and 60, validates pointer-device type ((type & 0xfd) == 1); NULL reports 0,0 and a non-pointer input reports -1,-1.

notes: UI owner callback only; output has two signed 32-bit fields. Static evidence only.
